input.body:
Dear Student Finance Team,

I am writing on behalf of Mr Lin Wei, parent of Ms Lin Yuxuan (Student ID: KG2601847), who has been admitted to the MSc programme starting January 2027.

We would like to pay the first instalment of tuition and accommodation fees before the start of term. Could you please send us:

1. An official fee statement for the first term tuition and accommodation, showing the exact amounts due in GBP;
2. Any deposit required and the payment deadline;
3. Your bank account details on official letterhead (account name, account number, sort code/IBAN and SWIFT/BIC) so that we can verify them and transfer safely;
4. The reference your bank requires for the payment (we understand this is the Student ID, but please confirm the exact format).

Please send the statement and bank letter to this address.

Kind regards,
CarryPay, on behalf of the family
Lin Yuxuan – Student ID KG2601847
